description: Use when an approved multi-phase spec should become tracked work: its phases, stages with acceptance and their order, for a new workstream or extending one; tracker seeds them. A one-phase spec is to-plan, then tracker; the plan for one phase is to-plan; a person's request to plan the work is the plan playbook, which calls this.
